head.title: Flags and disputes
head.subtitle: Rules raise flags; people decide. Nothing here blocks anyone automatically.

empty.openB: The rules keep watching new registrations and match-checks. Nothing needs a person right now.
empty.waitingB: When you pause an educator’s links, the case waits here until the owners answer.
empty.closedB: Dismissed and decided cases stay here with their resolution.
empty.mineT: Nothing is assigned to you here
empty.mineB: Assign yourself a case from the full list so others know you are on it.

many_owners_one_device.title: Many owners, one device
many_owners_one_device.why: Three or more people added a child from the same device and network within two hours. Families do register together — at a school meeting, on a teacher’s laptop — so call before you act.

surname_mismatch_group.title: All children in one group, different surnames
surname_mismatch_group.why: One owner added three or more children with different surnames, and all of them are in one educator’s group. It can be a large family or a guardian; it can also be an educator registering pupils under one phone.

owner_never_opens_reports.title: Owner never opens reports, waves always done
owner_never_opens_reports.why: The child took three or more waves this season, yet no guardian has ever opened a report. Someone other than the family may be running the profile.

match_check_bursts.title: Burst of match-checks
match_check_bursts.why: This educator ran ten or more match-checks in one hour, or missed fifteen or more in a day. Guessing which child belongs to which parent looks like this.

olympiad_fast_answers.title: Online olympiad answered implausibly fast
olympiad_fast_answers.why: An online olympiad stage was answered far faster than children usually read the questions, and almost everything was right. The child is not disqualified by this flag — a person decides.

fraud_flag.confirmed_educator_suspended: Confirmed and escalated: the educator’s account is suspended. Owners keep the choice for each link.

ownership_dispute.kept: The current owner keeps the profile. Both people received the decision and the reason.
ownership_dispute.transferred: Ownership moved to the claimant. Both people received the decision and the reason.

fifth_child.approved: Approved: the parent can add one more child.

detail.whyBody: No single signal is proof; the combination almost always is.
detail.privacy: PINFL is never shown here, not even partially. People appear as masked names; devices and networks as short hashes.
detail.linksSub: Each owner decides for their own child: keep the educator or end the access.
detail.waitB: The educator’s links were paused. The owners were told and each decides for their own child. Nobody is blocked automatically.

decide.title: Decision
decide.suspend: Suspend the teacher’s links and ask owners to confirm
decide.suspendHint: Not a silent block: links are paused, owners are told, and a person makes the call.
decide.closeHint: Each owner’s answer stands as given. Close the case once you have read them.
decide.suspendT: Suspend the links and ask owners to confirm?
decide.suspendB: {teacher} loses access to {n} children’s profiles until each owner answers. Nothing is deleted. The owners are told and decide for their own child: keep the educator or end the access. The educator sees only “access paused for review”, not the reason.
decide.dismissB: A false positive costs more than a miss: blocking an honest tutor loses us their whole group and our name among their colleagues. Nothing changes for anyone; the flag is closed and logged.
decide.dismissLbl: Why is this a false positive?
decide.dismissPh: What did you check, and what did you find?
decide.escalateB: The educator’s account is suspended; owners keep the choice for each link. The decision and your note are logged.
decide.escalateNoEdu: No educator is involved: the case is closed as confirmed and logged. Nobody is blocked automatically.
decide.escalatePh: What did you check, and why is it real?
decide.closeB: The owners’ answers stand as given. The case is closed and logged.
decide.noteErr: Add a note of at least 3 characters: the next reviewer needs to know why.

done.kept: {ref} resolved: the current owner keeps the profile. Both people are notified.
done.transferred: {ref} resolved: ownership moved to the claimant. Both people are notified.
done.approved: {ref}: one more child approved. The parent is notified.
done.rejected: {ref}: request rejected. The parent is notified.

dispute.why: One child, one owner. Adding a child who already has a profile never creates a second one — it opens this procedure. Write the decision down: the log answers any complaint later.
dispute.noOwner: The profile has no owner right now.
dispute.notConfirmed: The claimant hasn’t confirmed the claim yet. No decision until they do.
dispute.statementsSub: Neither side sees the other’s words or contact details.
dispute.callNotePh: Who you called, what they said, what you checked.
dispute.keepB: Nothing changes for the child’s profile. The claimant and the owner both receive the decision and the reason. The case is closed.
dispute.transferT: Transfer the child to the claimant?
dispute.transferB: A clean handover. This happens at once:
transferList: The old owner and every co-guardian lose access.
Open invites and any deletion request are cancelled.
Educator links wait for the new owner to keep or end them.
Consents must be given again by the new owner.
Both people are told the decision and the reason.

fifth.why: A family adds up to four children on its own. A fifth needs a person to look — most are real large families.
fifth.requestedLbl: The child they want to add
fifth.used: The approval was used: the child has been added.
fifth.approveB: The parent can add one more child. The approval is used once and the parent is notified.
fifth.rejectB: The parent cannot add this child. If you write a reason, the parent sees it.

app.title: The application
app.decideThere: Applications are decided on the Educator applications tab, with approve and reject.

notes.title: Notes
notes.sub: Every note is kept with the case. Shown as plain text.
notes.ph: What did you check or learn?

errors.UNKNOWN: Something went wrong. Please try again in a moment.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You don’t have permission to do this.
errors.NOT_FOUND: This case no longer exists. Refresh the page.
errors.NOT_TRUST_SAFETY: Cases can only be assigned to the trust & safety team.
errors.CASE_NOT_OPEN: This case is no longer open. Refresh the page.
errors.NO_EDUCATOR: No educator is involved in this flag, so there are no links to pause.
errors.CASE_CLOSED: This case is already closed. Refresh the page.
errors.CASE_NOT_WAITING: This case isn’t waiting for owners. Refresh the page.
errors.CLAIM_NOT_CONFIRMED: The claimant hasn’t confirmed the claim yet. Decide once they have.
errors.ALREADY_OWNER: The claimant already owns this child — there is nothing to transfer.

states.noAccessTitle: This section isn’t open to you
states.noAccessBody: Only the trust & safety team works the flags and disputes queue.
states.errBody: The rules are still running and recording flags — only this screen failed to load.
states.notFoundBody: The link may be wrong, or the case was removed. The queue has every open case.
